body: The two items are bundled beside marked feed sack; field dust lies beneath them, while a strip of road tape is caught around the bundle.
title: Marked feed sack by the kitchen chair
gloss: Field residue and response material share one personal bundle.
rival_reading: Field work and a hurried emergency response could each explain the mixed residue and road tape; neither fixes which came first.

body: The jar contains ash beneath its lid. A potato is wrapped in a clean bandage beside it. These were packed together before the fire spread; the jar was being carried out, while the food was left where it could be found.
title: Ash inside the sealed jar
gloss: A personal account or object records an intervention that left part of the account missing.
rival_reading: A farmer might have saved a sample of ash from a failed field treatment.
